text:
from the outside, it is very reasonable to interpret the past 2 weeks as an orchestrated industry-wide regulatory capture strategy.

I realize that no one has properly explained yet what all the lab employees have seen that scared them so suddenly.

I will try to explain -

first, this is all a matter of beliefs about how quickly model capabilities are progressing. there is currently a large gap between the internal and external perception of the rate of progress, which is what I am going to address here.

the general perception about the rate of progress has been informed by a few years of experience with model releases, intuitively feeling the capability jump between GPT3 -> GPT3.5 -> GPT4 -> o1/o3 -> GPT5 etc, and in particular seeing where the models are still far below human ability. there have really only been a few model releases that felt like large leaps in progress - GPT3, GPT4, o1/o3, DeepSeek R1, Fable/Mythos, Kimi K3 and now Astra.

because of the infrequency of these large jumps compared with the relatively common marginal releases, it has been easy to form a view at certain points that “scaling has hit a wall,” especially at points like GPT5 release. This view is comforting in that it feels like there is some universal rate limit beyond which we cannot progress too much faster. Between o1/o3 and Astra, there was a year of seemingly linear progress. So we extrapolate from here about how fast progress will “realistically” occur.

There is always an underlying question from the outside perspective “how long can this scaling stuff really keep going for? surely it must stop at some point soon, we’ve already gone pretty far.” and it is very possible to search for reasons why progress will stop working and find reasons that seem valid - (“models are already as large as they can get it would be too hard to do more parameters”, “we already used all the data on the internet we don’t have anymore”, “it’s gonna be pretty linear from here buying up more RL envs to bring them in distribution”).

From the inside of labs, researchers have direct answers to these questions in the form of scaling law/capability plots.

In reality, there are only really 2 ways that AI capabilities have advanced over the past decade: (1) either scale father on an existing scaling law or (2) discover a new scaling law to take advantage of.

All of the largest capability jumps were caused by exactly these factors. GPT2 was a pre-training scale-up compared to GPT1. Same for GPT3 and GPT4. o1/o3 benefited from the invention of a new scaling law axis - test-time compute. Perhaps Fable was a scale-up on both of these axes, or maybe more. Lots of algorithmic improvements are needed to make these scale-ups work, but ultimately we can approximate by saying that the scaling laws are what yield gains in capabilities (à la bitter lesson)

So the question of “how much father can we scale” is really - “how many more scaling axes do we know about that are unsaturated?”

If we hypothetically only knew about pre-training scaling, and we already had a 10T or 100T model, maybe it would be reasonable to say we’ve hit a wall. Same if we only knew about pre-training and test-time scaling and we had roughly saturated both methods.

But what if we had discovered new scaling laws? For example, let’s hypothetically use SSI’s rumored result that they have cracked “test-time training,” creating a new scaling law of spending more compute training during test-time rollouts that they could saturate. Or maybe there is some way to scale agent-clusters to collaborate up to N number of agents which we’re already seeing lots of people try that represents a new way to saturate compute. etc. Even recursive-self improvement can be thought of as a scaling law - how much compute do you spend on inference making the algorithms of the model better.

Obviously I am not saying any of these specific directions explicitly yield new scaling laws, but what I am saying is that it’s not hard to imagine many many new scaling axes aside from just the main 2 that we have seen publicly.

In some ways, every new lab release that represents a huge capability jump has to represent some new techniques developed which may exhibit new scaling laws, or the ability to scale much farther than expected on existing scaling axes.

From an internal perspective, this might look like sitting inside Anthropic with the new Mythos 5, seeing all of the new insane things it can do (like hack into xyz website that was thought to be secure), and then you look over at your plots and see that you’ve barely scratched the surface of 2 new scaling laws and 1 existing one. And you have WAY more room to go. Then you think “holy shit this stuff is going to get so much better very very soon.” And you can say that with pretty high confidence, because the plot is showing you, and the plot has never lied (so far).

So let’s imagine all the different labs are staring at their own plots and have concluded that there is no end in sight for scaling and in fact just their next 1-2 model generations based on the expected returns will have much higher base intelligence.

How much more intelligence do we actually get from further scaling?

As a proxy, we went from a complete inability to do advanced math before the o-series to solving a millenium prize problem with next-gen models. This happened in less than 2 years. The same happened in coding. And it appears that this was not just the result of 1-scaling law but the stacking effects of multiple (great pre-training scale x greater RL scale).

What you can concretely take from this is that in areas where models have shown beginning signs of competence today, they will probably be superhuman relatively shortly. There are many areas where models have not even shown this basic competence.

But one of the areas that they have happens to be hacking and cybersecurity. Which happens to be the gate to the entire internet and a massive amount physical infrastructure in the world. So assuming there is more room to scale, it is safe to assume that models will be superhuman at cyber capabilities in not too long.

So the only question remaining is what will this increased base intelligence be able to do, and what is it likely to do.

Finally, we are at a point where we can integrate the information of the past 2 weeks:
> Just at the existing point on the scaling curve, models are at the level of Astra. There is clearly a large number of things they are capable of hacking
> We have seen that both OAI and Ant models have shown a willingness to hack external websites to solve their tasks or keep themselves “alive”
> If we crank up the scaling even farther, assuming there is room to go, we will certainly have models that are far more able to hack more well defended places, and obfuscate their own intent, which might have much larger consequences.
> If all of this is allowed to go unchecked, we would likely have rapid runaway capability takeoff very soon, with misaligned models that hack whatever they can to get what they want
> This could of course have very damaging consequences.

Within this view you can see why researchers would be very scared, and why theymight have made the comments they have over the past 2 weeks (you may argue the extent to which they went was misguided for various reasons), and also why pacing the frontier is very much a necessity and by no means a regulatory capture strategy.

People are staring at their plots, seeing that there is no end in sight, but in fact very much the contrary, that there are compounding scaling effects that might stack on each other to create ever-greater model capabilities, and that at the same time we clearly do not have anywhere close to what's required to control these increasingly superhuman capabilities.

This has nothing to do with wanting to feel like the labs have produced something amazing so they are overhyping it. It is rather fear at the overwhelming implications of the knowledge that with just what we know now, we can create intelligences far more capable than us on every axis that we know how to train on*.

* and the last caveat, the things the models are really bad at, of which there are still many, are things that they have not been trained on. maybe there are the things the models can/will never be trained on, so they will remain human edge. I would love for this to be the case, though it is hard for me to see what would fall into that category.

10 GitHub repositories that feel almost illegal to be free.

And yes — they're all open source.

1. Archify

Turn your codebase into beautiful architecture, workflow, sequence and data-flow diagrams with AI.
Perfect for developers who want system design without manually drawing everything.

https://t.co/FCv7b8YlQP

2. OpenMAIC

An open-source multi-agent environment built around interactive AI workflows.
It shows what happens when multiple AI agents can collaborate inside the same environment.

https://t.co/YmoEeurwr1

3. DeepSeek Harness

A powerful open-source harness for building and running AI coding workflows.
Built for developers who want more control over how AI agents work with real codebases.

https://t.co/R6bhDirKV3

4. Ponytail

Makes AI coding agents follow a surprisingly simple principle: write less code when you don't need it.
A fascinating approach to making agents behave more like experienced senior developers.

https://t.co/HBMfFxQZBr

5. Agent Skills

A collection of reusable skills that upgrade what AI coding agents can do.
Plug these into your agent workflow and give your AI much more specialized capabilities.

https://t.co/iyWBG5buKJ

6. OmniVoice Studio

An open-source AI voice generation and processing studio.
Useful for experimenting with modern voice workflows without depending entirely on closed platforms.

https://t.co/BXTpGydT9w

7. Scientific Agent Skills

A collection of specialized skills designed to help AI agents perform scientific research.
One of the more interesting projects if you're exploring AI agents beyond coding.

https://t.co/lVnFW0GysU

8. Orca

An agentic development environment for running multiple coding agents in parallel.
Think of it as giving your development workflow a whole fleet of AI workers.

https://t.co/GsA7Xbsjp0

9. MiniMind

A surprisingly compact project for understanding how modern language models work.
Great for developers who want to learn by actually building instead of only reading theory.

https://t.co/36mwVOOYPl

10. God's Eye View

A visual project exploring how AI can understand and represent complex systems.
A very interesting repository for anyone working around AI visualization and agent workflows.

https://t.co/EYSzVX5HEV

All open source.

Some are useful today.
Some are worth studying.
And some might become huge.

Bookmark this list and save it for the weekend.

AMNESTY INTERNATIONAL TURUN TANGAN DAN BERSUARA UNTUK MENGHENTIKAN PROGRAM MBG (MAKAN BERGIZI GRTAIS) 

Bobroknya tata kelola MBG, ditambah lambannya pembenahan yang dijanjikan pemerintah, membuat program ini semakin tidak layak untuk diteruskan. Selain itu, demi menyelamatkan kesehatan dan nyawa anak-anak Indonesia, negara harus segera menghentikan program MBG. Program ini tidak boleh dilanjutkan sebelum ada jaminan keselamatan pangan yang ketat dan sistem yang benar-benar akuntabel. KERACUNAN MASSAL MBG TERJADI LAGI! 

49 Siswa SMAN 3 Nganjuk Dilarikan ke RSUD, Wabup Handy Turun Tangan! 

Rabu, 2 September 2026

Gelombang dugaan keracunan makanan akibat program Makan Bergizi Gratis (MBG) kembali memakan korban! Kali ini musibah menimpa puluhan siswa-siswi SMAN 3 Nganjuk, Jawa Timur.

Berdasarkan data sementara, sekitar 49 siswa mendadak mengalami gejala mual, pusing, hingga muntah-muntah hebat setelah mengonsumsi menu MBG yang dibagikan di sekolah pada Rabu siang. Para siswa langsung dievakuasi secara cepat menggunakan ambulans dan kendaraan operasional menuju beberapa fasilitas kesehatan di Kabupaten Nganjuk.

📍 Rincian Penanganan & Tindakan Cepat di Lapangan:

1. Penanganan Medis Skala Darurat
Wakil Bupati Nganjuk, Trihandy Cahyo Saputro (Mas Handy), bergerak cepat meninjau langsung kondisi para siswa di RSUD Nganjuk. Pemkab Nganjuk memfokuskan penanganan medis di RSUD Nganjuk, RS Bhayangkara Nganjuk, serta beberapa puskesmas terdekat dengan menyiagakan dokter spesialis dan perawat penuh .

2. Evaluasi & Sanksi Administratif SPPG
Pemkab Nganjuk menegaskan akan mengkaji secara mendalam keberadaan Satuan Pelayanan Pemenuhan Gizi (SPPG) penyedia menu MBG tersebut. Langkah tegas berupa sanksi administratif hingga usulan penangguhan terhadap SPPG terkait sedang disiapkan setelah proses investigasi selesai.

3. Pendalaman & Uji Laboratorium
Aparat kepolisian bersama tim Dinas Kesehatan Kabupaten Sidoarjo dan Nganjuk kini tengah mengambil sampel sisa makanan MBG untuk menguji kandungan bakteri atau zat berbahaya guna memastikan penyebab utama kejadian berulang ini.

🔍 Catatan Kritis Evaluasi Nasional:
Hanya berselang sehari setelah kejadian keracunan massal 293 santri di Sidoarjo, kasus di SMAN 3 Nganjuk ini mempertegas perlunya pengawasan rantai pasok dan higienitas katering MBG secara total di seluruh wilayah Jawa Timur!

Sejumlah ibu, akademisi, aktivis, dan seniman menggelar aksi “Jalan Sore Pukul Panci” dari Tugu Golong Gilig menuju Bundaran UGM, Yogyakarta, Selasa (8/9/2026) sore.

Aksi yang dikemas dalam jalan sehat ini digelar untuk menyuarakan keresahan atas karut-marut program Makan Bergizi Gratis (MBG), termasuk rentetan kasus keracunan massal yang terjadi di sejumlah daerah.

Massa melakukan longmarch sambil memukul panci dan mengajak pengguna jalan membunyikan klakson. Aksi tersebut menjadi simbol agar suara dan kritik masyarakat didengar pemerintah.

Dalam aksinya, massa mendesak pemerintah menghentikan MBG dan mengalihkan anggarannya untuk mitigasi serta penanganan bencana.

Mereka juga menuntut penghentian kekerasan dan intimidasi terhadap masyarakat sipil serta menolak upaya membenturkan konflik horizontal untuk meredam kritik.

text:
Giving an AI agent your passwords is insane. Someone built the open-source alternative.

The problem sits under every agent demo you've seen. An agent that reads your email, updates your Notion, and files your invoices needs your logins, and that handover of raw passwords and API keys is where most people close the tab.

OpenConnector puts an open-source gateway between the agent and your apps. Credentials stay locked behind the runtime while the agent gets a catalog of ready-made actions for over 800 services, from Gmail and Slack to Notion and Airtable. The agent asks for an action, the gateway runs it against the real service, and the secrets never touch the model's context.

The controls are the part I like. You decide which actions an agent can touch through allow and block policies, scope access per connection, hand out runtime tokens instead of real keys, and read redacted logs of every run.

It speaks MCP out of the box, ships thousands of prebuilt actions in TypeScript, and self-hosts with one Docker command or a push to Cloudflare. The project is young, and the whole stack, from the provider catalog to the action executors, sits open for anyone to inspect.

Agents are getting hands. A gateway like this decides what those hands are allowed to hold, and I'd rather that layer be open source than a black box.

text:
Kontaminasi terjadi di jalur distribusi?

Kalau baca hasil uji laboratorium UPTD Labkes Sumut atas kasus keracunan MBG di SMAN 1 Berastagi ini ada  pola yg menarik. Sampel dr dapur pusat negatif dari empat parameter cemaran (Salmonella, E. Coli, Staphylococcus aureus, Bacillus cereus), sementara sampel  yg diambil di titik penyajian sekolah justru positif. Nasi tercemar Bacillus cereus, ikan dencis bersaus tercemar Staphylococcus aureus, dan melon tercemar E. Coli. Artinya, sumber masalah bukan pd proses memasak, melainkan pada rantai setelahnya saat pengemasan, transportasi, dan waktu tunggu sebelum makanan disantap siswa. (dg catatan tdk ada sumber toksin lain yg tdk diuji lab tsb...) 

Tiga bakteri tsb punya mekanisme bahaya yang berbeda namun sama-sama mengarah pd lemahnya kontrol suhu dan higiene pasca-produksi. Bacillus cereus berkembang biak dan memproduksi toksin cereulide ketika nasi dibiarkan pada suhu ruang terlalu lama. Toksin ini tahan panas sehingga tidak hilang meski dipanaskan ulang. Staphylococcus aureus umumnya berasal dari kontak tangan penjamah makanan yang tidak higienis setelah proses masak selesai. Sementara E. Coli pada melon mengindikasikan kontaminasi fekal, kemungkinan dari air cuci atau alat potong yang tidak bersih saat penyajian buah.

Tapi intinya, kalau data ini bener, sebenarnya bisa mengonfirmasi kelemahan struktural yang lebih luas dalam program MBG. Dapur bersertifikat tdk ada menjamin makanan aman, apalagi jk tdk ada kontrol ketat atas suhu penyimpanan dan higiene di titik distribusi terakhir. Selama waktu tempuh dari dapur ke sekolah dan jeda sebelum makan siang masih panjang dan lama, kasus serupa berisiko terus berulang. Dan ini jelas bukan insiden tunggal, melainkan gejala sistemik di rantai pasok program.

11 LLM eval methods AI engineers must know:

(bookmark this)

The tricky part about LLM evaluation is that there is no single metric that tells you whether a system is good.

The right evaluation method depends on what you are trying to measure. You may want to compare an output against a known answer, judge whether it is semantically correct, inspect how an agent behaved across multiple steps, or block unsafe outputs before they reach the user.

A useful way to organize them is by what they are actually evaluating.

𝗥𝗲𝗳𝗲𝗿𝗲𝗻𝗰𝗲-𝗯𝗮𝘀𝗲𝗱 𝗲𝘃𝗮𝗹𝘀, 𝘄𝗵𝗲𝗻 𝗴𝗿𝗼𝘂𝗻𝗱 𝘁𝗿𝘂𝘁𝗵 𝗲𝘅𝗶𝘀𝘁𝘀

→ BLEU measures n-gram precision, checking how much of the generated text overlaps with the reference.

→ ROUGE focuses more on recall, measuring how much of the reference content appears in the output.

→ BERTScore compares contextual embeddings instead of exact words, so semantically similar answers can still score well.

𝗝𝘂𝗱𝗴𝗲-𝗯𝗮𝘀𝗲𝗱 𝗲𝘃𝗮𝗹𝘀, 𝘄𝗵𝗲𝗻 𝗴𝗿𝗼𝘂𝗻𝗱 𝘁𝗿𝘂𝘁𝗵 𝗶𝘀 𝘂𝗻𝗮𝘃𝗮𝗶𝗹𝗮𝗯𝗹𝗲 𝗼𝗿 𝗶𝗻𝗰𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗹𝗲𝘁𝗲

→ G-Eval uses an LLM to score an output against defined criteria.

→ LLM-as-Judge gives a model a rubric and asks it to score or compare outputs.

→ LLM Juries run multiple independent judges and aggregate their verdicts, reducing dependence on a single evaluator.

𝗛𝘂𝗺𝗮𝗻 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗱𝗲𝘁𝗲𝗿𝗺𝗶𝗻𝗶𝘀𝘁𝗶𝗰 𝗲𝘃𝗮𝗹𝘀

→ Human Evaluation relies on people to score outputs across dimensions such as correctness, relevance, and helpfulness.

→ DAG-based Evaluation encodes evaluation as deterministic decision logic, routing outputs through explicit checks until a final verdict is reached.

𝗘𝘃𝗮𝗹𝘀 𝗯𝘂𝗶𝗹𝘁 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝗮𝗴𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘀

→ Trajectory Accuracy evaluates the sequence of actions an agent took, not just the final answer.

→ Multi-turn Evaluation scores behavior across an entire conversation, including consistency, memory, and coherence across turns.

𝗘𝘃𝗮𝗹𝘀 𝘁𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗿𝘂𝗻 𝗮𝘀 𝗴𝗮𝘁𝗲𝘀

→ Safety Evaluation checks for things such as toxicity, bias, sensitive-data leakage, and policy violations before an output is accepted.

The important part is that these methods are complementary.

A production agent may need reference-based evals for correctness, judge-based evals for subjective quality, trajectory evals for tool use, and safety evals before anything reaches the user.

If you are building this evaluation layer, Comet’s Opik brings tracing, debugging, test suites, and agent evals into one open-source stack.

Check it out on GitHub: https://t.co/MEC26owCdo

(don't forget to star 🌟)

I also wrote a deeper breakdown of how evaluation fits into a production observability and self-repair loop.

The full article is quoted below.

Mahasiswa UII Gelar Aksi Demonstrasi di Titik Nol Kilometer Jogja, Bawa 6 Tuntutan Krusial

YOGYAKARTA – Kawasan Titik Nol Kilometer Yogyakarta siang ini dipadati oleh ratusan massa yang mengenakan almamater biru khas Universitas Islam Indonesia (UII). Senin (15/6/2026) pukul 14.04 WIB massa mahasiswa tampak berkumpul membentuk lingkaran besar di tengah persimpangan jalan, didampingi oleh sebuah mobil komando lengkap dengan bendera-bendera aksi.
Aksi yang diinisiasi oleh Aliansi "UII Bergerak" dan Lembaga Eksekutif Mahasiswa Fakultas Hukum UII (LEMFH UII) ini merupakan bentuk respon kritis terhadap berbagai kebijakan pemerintah saat ini. Arus lalu lintas di sekitar lokasi tampak melambat namun tetap dikawal oleh pihak kepolisian demi menjaga kondusivitas di lapangan.

6 Poin Tuntutan Utama Massa Aksi
Melalui selebaran digital yang disebarkan , massa aksi secara tegas mengusung enam poin tuntutan utama yang ditujukan kepada pemerintah pusat maupun daerah:
1. Pemberhentian Total Program MBG dan KOPDES: Menuntut penghentian total program Makan Bergizi Gratis (MBG) serta operasional Koperasi Desa Merah Putih (KOPDES).
2. Penurunan Harga Kebutuhan Pokok: Mendesak pemerintah segera menurunkan harga BBM dan harga komoditas bahan pokok yang dinilai kian mencekik daya beli masyarakat.
3. Perbaikan Kebijakan Fiskal: Menuntut pemerintah untuk segera memperbaiki tata kelola kebijakan fiskal dan keuangan negara demi kestabilan ekonomi makro.
4. Reformasi Polri: Menuntut kejelasan progres reformasi di tubuh Kepolisian RI serta mendesak adanya revisi terhadap UU Polri.
5. Hentikan Militerisme Sipil: Menolak keras segala bentuk pendekatan militerisme yang masuk ke dalam ranah sipil.
6. Perbaikan Pola Komunikasi Pemerintah: Menuntut pemerintah untuk memperbaiki pola komunikasi publiknya dan secara jantan mengakui kesalahan-kesalahan kebijakan yang telah diambil.

Meski sempat memicu kepadatan kendaraan di jantung Kota Yogyakarta, jalannya unjuk rasa ini dilaporkan berlangsung secara damai dan tertib. Orasi demi orasi terus digelorakan dari atas mobil komando, diiringi lagu-lagu perjuangan mahasiswa.
Hingga berita ini diturunkan, massa mahasiswa masih bertahan di lokasi untuk menyuarakan aspirasi mereka, dengan pengawalan ketat dari aparat gabungan guna memastikan aksi tidak mengganggu ketertiban umum secara berlebihan.

kalau yang tersisa hanya kesatuan di bendera
dan ketimpangan di dapur.

Dukung Indonesia menjadi negara federal.
Satu bangsa.
Kuasa yang adil.
Hasil yang tidak kabur ke Jakarta.

text:
Analisis Mikrobiologis Kasus Keracunan Massal MBG dan Tinjauan Penegakan Hukumnya.

Hasil uji laboratorium terhadap sampel makanan dari kasus keracunan massal program Makan Bergizi Gratis (MBG) di Berastagi menunjukkan adanya kontaminasi bakteri patogen yang berisiko tinggi. Berdasarkan analisis medis, ditemukan beberapa agen penyebab utama:

 * Bacillus\ cereus: Terdeteksi pada sampel nasi. Bakteri ini merupakan pembentuk spora yang sering mencemari makanan berkarbohidrat tinggi. Spora dan toksin yang dihasilkannya dapat bertahan dari proses pemanasan ulang, memicu sindrom muntah atau diare akut.
 * Staphylococcus\ aureus: Ditemukan pada sampel ikan, ayam, dan sampel muntah siswa. Bakteri ini umumnya mencemari makanan melalui kontak fisik dari "penjamah" makanan (kulit/saluran pernapasan). Jika makanan disimpan pada suhu yang tidak tepat, bakteri akan berkembang biak dan memproduksi enterotoksin yang sangat tahan panas, menyebabkan keracunan akut.
 * Escherichia\ coli (E.\ coli): Terdeteksi pada sampel melon. Infeksi E.\ coli, khususnya strain STEC (Shiga toxin-producing E. coli), membawa risiko komplikasi yang sangat berat, termasuk kerusakan sel darah merah, penurunan trombosit, hingga gagal ginjal akut melalui sindrom uremik hemolitik (HUS).

Lebih lanjut, dokter juga menyoroti adanya risiko komplikasi ke sistem saraf otak yang dapat menyebabkan amnesia, yang kemungkinan dipicu oleh kondisi syok atau sepsis akibat infeksi yang tidak segera tertangani dengan baik.

Ironi Penegakan Hukum
Di balik temuan klinis yang mengancam nyawa ini, terdapat celah besar dalam pertanggungjawaban hukum. Seperti yang ditegaskan oleh Prof. Mahfud MD, pihak SPPG yang bertanggung jawab atas penyelenggaraan makanan dan menyebabkan banyak anak keracunan, hingga saat ini tidak diproses hukum atau dipidanakan. 

Penanganan kasus ini dinilai hanya sebatas teguran formalitas belaka, tanpa ada tindakan tegas yang sepadan dengan bahaya yang mengancam keselamatan kesehatan anak-anak.

Kasus keracunan massal bukanlah hal sepele; ini adalah darurat kesehatan masyarakat yang membutuhkan evaluasi sistemik dan penegakan hukum yang transparan agar tidak terus berulang.😮‍💨

text:
Viral Kaki Seribu Ditemukan dalam Lauk Menu MBG untuk Ibu Hamil di Pasangkayu

Temuan potongan hewan kaki seribu dalam lauk program Makan Bergizi Gratis (MBG) untuk ibu hamil di Kabupaten Pasangkayu, Sulawesi Barat (Sulbar), menjadi perhatian setelah videonya beredar di media sosial.

Peristiwa tersebut terjadi di Posyandu Kembang Sawit, Kecamatan Lariang, Pasangkayu, pada Kamis (10/9/2026). Potongan kaki seribu disebut ditemukan dalam salah satu ompreng atau wadah makanan MBG yang akan dibagikan kepada penerima manfaat.

Koordinator Badan Gizi Nasional (BGN) Sulawesi Barat, Firazh Ahmadila, membenarkan adanya temuan tersebut. Menurutnya, potongan kaki seribu ditemukan oleh kader posyandu sebelum makanan dibagikan kepada ibu hamil.

"Benar (ditemukan kaki seribu di lauk menu MBG)," kata Firazh kepada detikcom, Kamis (10/9/2026).

Firazh menjelaskan, temuan tersebut hanya terdapat pada satu ompreng. Makanan yang berisi potongan kaki seribu itu juga dipastikan belum sempat dikonsumsi oleh penerima manfaat.

"Ompreng yang ada kaki seribu belum dikonsumsi. Pihak SPPG juga sudah langsung ke Posyandu tersebut," ujarnya.

Setelah menerima laporan, pihak Satuan Pelayanan Pemenuhan Gizi (SPPG) yang bertanggung jawab atas penyediaan menu tersebut langsung mendatangi lokasi untuk melakukan penanganan.

BGN masih melakukan penyelidikan guna mengetahui bagaimana hewan tersebut dapat masuk ke dalam makanan yang disiapkan untuk program MBG. Pemeriksaan diperlukan untuk memastikan sumber kontaminasi sekaligus mengevaluasi proses pengolahan dan distribusi makanan.

Sebagai langkah sementara, operasional SPPG Pasangkayu Lariang Singgani yang menyediakan menu MBG tersebut dihentikan atau disuspend.

"SPPG tersebut sudah di-suspend," tegas Firazh.

Sementara itu, video yang beredar di media sosial memperlihatkan seorang perempuan menunjukkan lauk berupa sayur yang disebut berasal dari menu MBG. Di dalam sayuran tersebut terlihat potongan hewan yang diduga merupakan kaki seribu.

Hewan tersebut tampak sudah dalam kondisi terpotong. Dalam rekaman, perempuan yang mengambil video juga menyebut potongan kaki seribu itu ditemukan dalam keadaan matang bersama sayuran.

"Kaki seribunya matang sama daun ubinya ini, matang dengan sempurna, syukur bukan anak-anak yang dapat ini, keracunan kalau anak-anak," ujar perempuan tersebut dalam video.

Meski demikian, pernyataan mengenai potensi keracunan yang disampaikan dalam video merupakan komentar dari pihak yang merekam dan bukan kesimpulan medis. Hingga saat ini, fokus penanganan masih pada penyelidikan mengenai penyebab masuknya benda asing tersebut ke dalam makanan.

Temuan ini menjadi perhatian karena menu MBG diperuntukkan bagi kelompok penerima manfaat yang membutuhkan perhatian khusus terhadap keamanan dan kualitas pangan, termasuk ibu hamil. Penghentian sementara operasional SPPG menjadi langkah yang diambil sembari proses pemeriksaan dilakukan.

BGN diharapkan dapat menyampaikan hasil penyelidikan lebih lanjut mengenai penyebab kejadian tersebut serta memastikan standar keamanan pangan dalam penyediaan menu MBG tetap terpenuhi.

"Benar (ditemukan kaki seribu di lauk menu MBG)," kata Firazh kepada detikcom, Kamis (10/9/2026). Firazh menjelaskan, temuan tersebut hanya terdapat pada satu ompreng. Makanan yang berisi potongan kaki seribu itu juga dipastikan belum sempat dikonsumsi oleh penerima manfaat. "Ompreng yang ada kaki seribu belum dikonsumsi. Pihak SPPG juga sudah langsung ke Posyandu tersebut," ujarnya. Setelah menerima laporan, pihak Satuan Pelayanan Pemenuhan Gizi (SPPG) yang bertanggung jawab atas penyediaan menu tersebut langsung mendatangi lokasi untuk melakukan penanganan. BGN masih melakukan penyelidikan guna mengetahui bagaimana hewan tersebut dapat masuk ke dalam makanan yang disiapkan untuk program MBG. Pemeriksaan diperlukan untuk memastikan sumber kontaminasi sekaligus mengevaluasi proses pengolahan dan distribusi makanan. Sebagai langkah sementara, operasional SPPG Pasangkayu Lariang Singgani yang menyediakan menu MBG tersebut dihentikan atau disuspend. "SPPG tersebut sudah di-suspend," tegas Firazh. Sementara itu, video yang beredar di media sosial memperlihatkan seorang perempuan menunjukkan lauk berupa sayur yang disebut berasal dari menu MBG. Di dalam sayuran tersebut terlihat potongan hewan yang diduga merupakan kaki seribu. Hewan tersebut tampak sudah dalam kondisi terpotong. Dalam rekaman, perempuan yang mengambil video juga menyebut potongan kaki seribu itu ditemukan dalam keadaan matang bersama sayuran. "Kaki seribunya matang sama daun ubinya ini, matang dengan sempurna, syukur bukan anak-anak yang dapat ini, keracunan kalau anak-anak," ujar perempuan tersebut dalam video. Meski demikian, pernyataan mengenai potensi keracunan yang disampaikan dalam video merupakan komentar dari pihak yang merekam dan bukan kesimpulan medis. Hingga saat ini, fokus penanganan masih pada penyelidikan mengenai penyebab masuknya benda asing tersebut ke dalam makanan. Temuan ini menjadi perhatian karena menu MBG diperuntukkan bagi kelompok penerima manfaat yang membutuhkan perhatian khusus terhadap keamanan dan kualitas pangan, termasuk ibu hamil. Penghentian sementara operasional SPPG menjadi langkah yang diambil sembari proses pemeriksaan dilakukan. BGN diharapkan dapat menyampaikan hasil penyelidikan lebih lanjut mengenai penyebab kejadian tersebut serta memastikan standar keamanan pangan dalam penyediaan menu MBG tetap terpenuhi.

text:
Mengklaim bahwa konstitusi secara spesifik mewajibkan negara menyediakan Makan Bergizi Gratis (MBG) adalah sebuah manipulasi logika yang menggelikan. Pasal 34 UUD 1945 memang mengamanatkan negara untuk memelihara fakir miskin, tetapi tidak pernah sekalipun mendiktekan keharusan membagi-bagikan makan siang. Menjadikan konstitusi sebagai tameng pelindung hanyalah akal-akalan untuk menutupi kecacatan mendasar dari program tersebut.
Pengakuan Zulkifli Hasan atas kegagalan MBG—setelah dua tahun berjalan dan menghanguskan triliunan uang pajak rakyat—sama sekali bukan tindakan ksatria, melainkan deklarasi terbuka atas inkompetensi absolut. Membiarkan sebuah program bermasalah terus bergulir selama itu tanpa evaluasi tegas menunjukkan lumpuhnya fungsi pengawasan pemerintah. Lebih parah lagi, solusi yang ditawarkan sangat dangkal. Mengganti manajemen dengan sosok anak muda hanyalah gimmick kosmetik belaka. Apabila cetak biru kebijakannya sudah cacat sejak lahir, menaruh siapa pun di pucuk pimpinan tidak akan memperbaiki keadaan. Meminta tambahan toleransi waktu satu hingga dua bulan setelah membuang sia-sia waktu dua tahun adalah lelucon konyol dan bentuk nyata pelarian dari tanggung jawab.
Argumen bahwa MBG mampu memutus rantai kemiskinan dan gizi buruk sungguh mencerminkan cara pandang yang luar biasa kerdil. Penanganan kemiskinan menuntut perbaikan yang fundamental, seperti penguatan daya beli, penciptaan lapangan kerja riil, serta akses pendidikan dan kesehatan yang terpadu. Mengerdilkan solusi dari masalah sistemik menjadi sekadar program bagi-bagi makanan adalah sebuah penghinaan terhadap akal sehat publik.
Pada akhirnya, dalih usang bahwa "pelaksanaannya yang salah, bukan kebijakannya" hanyalah apologi murahan agar para elit pembuat keputusan bisa cuci tangan. Kebijakan yang mungkin terlihat indah di atas kertas namun mustahil dieksekusi dengan baik di lapangan adalah definisi mutlak dari kebijakan yang buruk. Terus-menerus memisahkan kegagalan desain dari realitas eksekusi sekadar membuktikan bahwa pembuat kebijakan sejak awal memang tidak berpijak pada dunia nyata.

A recent paper showed AI self-replication is no longer technically hypothetical. 

Current agents can hack, copy themselves to a new server, and keep going, so this capability now belongs in real AI security planning.

The paper actually demonstrates the full loop rather than testing isolated pieces.

Agents found vulnerabilities, extracted credentials, transferred model weights and the agent software, started inference on the compromised machine, and then used the new replica to attack the next target.

Qwen3.6-27B completed a 3-hop chain across 4 VMs on 3 continents from 1 initial prompt, with no human intervention after launch.

But this does not mean AI agents are freely spreading across the internet, here in this experiment, the targets were intentionally vulnerable lab systems with known hostnames, available GPUs, and unusually accessible SSH credentials.

Microsoft open-sourced an AI Engineer Coach!

AI Engineer Coach is a VS Code extension that reads your local AI coding session logs and turns them into actionable insights. Works with any harness - Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, Codex, Cline. Everything runs on your machine. No data leaves.

Most developers using AI coding tools don't know if they're actually getting better at using them. What prompts they repeat. What habits are slowing them down. What their context health looks like. This extension answers all of that.

Four layers:

1. Observe - Practice scores with week-over-week trends, daily activity charts, Gantt-style session timeline, and a screenshot gallery from your coding sessions.

2. Measure - AI-generated code volume broken down by language, model, workspace, and harness. Activity heatmaps showing your 7×24 coding patterns.

3. Improve - 45 anti-pattern rules across prompt quality, session hygiene, code review, tool mastery, and context management. Each rule comes with severity ratings and concrete actions. Skill Finder discovers repeated prompt patterns and matches them to reusable skills from the open-source catalog. Context Health runs agentic readiness checks and audits your instruction files.

4. Level Up - Personalized quizzes generated from your actual usage data. XP-based progression with Bronze to Diamond tiers. An Agentic SDLC view showing how you use AI across the full development lifecycle.

text:
Lightfield's CRM costs nothing. Users spend an hour a day in it.

Agents made individuals a lot more productive this year and mostly skipped the sales org. A person carries their own context in their head. A company's context sits in a CRM, and that record was never built for a machine to reason over.

A Salesforce or HubSpot object still leans on what a rep typed after the call, or what a workflow auto-filled. The record is incomplete, shaped by one person's memory of the conversation, and laid out for a dashboard. Bolt an agent onto that and you get confident nonsense at scale, which is what most AI for CRM demos I've seen this year delivered.

That is a data problem wearing an AI costume.

Lightfield is a partner, opinions are mine.

Their bet, per Keith Peiris's announcement quoted here, is to rebuild the record itself. Lightfield ingests calls, email, Slack and LinkedIn into what the team calls a customer world model, a live structured picture of every account that both people and agents work from. The pitch is that agents for pipeline gen, meeting prep, follow-up, record hygiene and reporting sit on top of the world model.

Every record is readable and writable over API, MCP and CLI, so in principle you point your own agent at it and build on it like infrastructure. The founders of Vercel, Mercury and WorkOS are angels, which fits.

Pricing follows the argument. Core CRM free, no seat charges, and the only bill is for the agent work. The company reports 5,000+ signups since the November launch, and one customer moved ~10,000 contacts and ~2,600 opportunities off Salesforce onto it.

If you were picking a first CRM in 2026 I'd ask one question first. Can an agent read the whole record and trust it? That question is going to shape how CRMs get built for years, and a lot of what's installed today was never designed with an agent as the reader.

text:
Kasus Keracunan MBG di Sidoarjo Meluas ke 19 Sekolah, Total Korban Tembus 566 Orang

Selengkapnya baca di sini: https://t.co/GJwmRarqq8

Jumlah korban dugaan keracunan menu Makan Bergizi Gratis (MBG) yang disalurkan oleh Satuan Pelayanan Pemenuhan Gizi (SPPG) Kalitengah, Tanggulangin, Kabupaten Sidoarjo, Jawa Timur, terus bertambah.

Hingga Rabu (2/9/2026) siang, total korban melonjak menjadi 566 orang.

Kasus ini tidak hanya menimpa santri Pondok Pesantren (Ponpes) Manba’ul Hikam Putat Tanggulangin, tetapi juga meluas dan berdampak pada siswa dari 19 sekolah lain di wilayah tersebut.

Dinas Kesehatan (Dinkes) Kabupaten Sidoarjo mengonfirmasi adanya lonjakan angka korban setelah sejumlah pasien yang sebelumnya bertahan di posko lapangan Ponpes Manba’ul Hikam harus dirujuk ke rumah sakit.

"Total jumlah 531 kalau enggak salah. Tapi barusan ada tambahan 35 (yang dirujuk ke rumah sakit), jadi total 566 lah," kata Kepala Dinas Kesehatan Sidoarjo, Lakhsmie Herawati Yuwantina, Rabu (2/9/2026).

Dari total 566 korban terdampak, sebanyak 88 orang di antaranya saat ini masih menjalani perawatan medis intensif di sejumlah rumah sakit terdekat.

Petugas medis terpaksa mengevaluasi puluhan santri yang sebelumnya dirawat di lokasi kejadian.

"Yang kemarin kita pertahankan untuk di masjid sebagai apa lapangan, itu ternyata memang harus kami evakuasi ke rumah sakit kurang lebih ada 35," jelas Lakhsmie.

Sejumlah rumah sakit yang menjadi rujukan para korban antara lain RSUD R.T. Notopuro, RS Delta Surya, RS Siti Hajar, RS Pusura, RSU Aisyiyah St Fatimah Tulangan, RS Pusdik Bhayangkara, hingga RS Arafah Anwar Medika.

Meski jumlah korban yang dirawat cukup banyak, Dinkes Sidoarjo memastikan kondisi para pasien tergolong stabil dan tidak ada yang membutuhkan perawatan khusus.

"Secara umum yang opname stabil. Secara umum stabil, tidak ada yang perlu dikhawatirkan sampai ke perawatan khusus enggak ada," tambah Lakhsmie.

Sementara itu, sekitar 470 korban lainnya telah dipulangkan atau menjalani rawat jalan setelah kondisinya dinyatakan mulai membaik.

Kendati demikian, tim medis tetap melakukan pemantauan berkala terhadap para siswa dari 19 sekolah serta para santri yang sudah berada di rumah.

"Ya, tentunya kalau misalnya memang dirasa perlu masih ada keluhan, ya kontrol. Kalau tidak, dengan obat yang sudah diberikan cukup, ya cukup, selesai," pungkasnya.

~KS #articleonfeed #keracunanmbg

Someone gave Astra 6 and Fable 5.1 the exact same prompt: “build me GTA”

Both had to autonomously build a browser open-world game where you can walk around, steal cars, drive through traffic and crash them.

Fable 5.1:
~6h 15m
4.58M tokens
13 implementer + 19 reviewer agents

Astra 6:
~55 min of actual work
7.23M tokens
1 agent

And Astra produced the noticeably better game.

One-shot game generation is becoming a surprisingly useful benchmark for coding agents.

Product First, Token Later: A Perspective on My SLEEP @sleepagotchi 

In the crypto world, there is a familiar sequence: launch a token, create incentives, attract attention, generate trading activity and only then seek the answer to the question,

 "What do users actually do with this token?" That sequence might generate fleeting excitement, but it rarely builds a genuine economy.

With Sleepagotchi’s  SLEEP, the focus isn't on price volatility, but on whether the product generates enough recurring activity to justify the token's existence. In other words: product utility comes first, followed by token utility.

Tokens Tied to Activity, Not Slogans
Sleepagotchi has outlined various use cases for SLEEP: credits for AI agents, subscription benefits, staking tiers, gamification rewards, wellness challenges, marketplace access, partner campaigns, and partial governance rights. 

The common thread among these isn't the "token" itself, but the activity involved.
The clearest example is AI credits. 

If the Sleep Coach truly understands a user's sleep patterns over weeks or months, then the need for deeper analysis, increased interaction with the agent, or expanded context for the Wellness Coach becomes a genuine demand. 

When SLEEP serves as the gateway to that value, the token becomes linked to a service users already want rather than a "token sink" devised merely to manufacture artificial demand.
A Two-Way Economic Loop
A sustainable ecosystem cannot rely solely on users exchanging value among themselves; external demand is essential. 

This is where the wellness marketplace and brand partners become crucial: a partner organizes a challenge, users participate, the product records the interaction, and users receive rewards, while the partner gains measurable engagement. SLEEP can serve as the mechanism for access, rewards, or participation within that loop. Caution is WƯaranted

It is important to emphasize that this direction is still being refined by the Sleepagotchi team in collaboration with partners and legal advisors; it is not yet a finalized or operational mechanism. A robust utility model should not be announced prematurely merely to generate a narrative it must align with the final product.

Conclusion
The critical question is not whether SLEEP can generate buzz for Sleepagotchi, but rather whether Sleepagotchi can generate enough meaningful activity to give  SLEEP a genuine purpose. 

While a token can drive short-term engagement, the product itself must ultimately prove its value. Only when the product successfully retains users can a well-designed token effectively orchestrate value around that activity in a sustainable way.

- BEKUKAN DAN INVESTIGASI PIDANA Dapur SPPG Ngemplak serta seluruh penyedia katering MBG bermasalah di Rembang!
- Buka secara transparan hasil uji sampel laboratorium makanan MAN Lasem dan SMAN 1 Lasem ke publik!
- Usut tuntas transparansi proses penunjukan vendor katering MBG agar tidak ada praktik bagi-bagi proyek di atas keselamatan siswa!

Jangan biarkan sekolah dan madrasah kita berubah jadi sarang racun katering!

good wellness AI shouldnt just understand you better.

it should help you understand yourself better too.

today @sleepagotchi used a simple snoring example: Dino notices a signal, then asks Sleep Coach what it means.

the interesting part for me isnt the snore.

its the teaching loop.

signal → explanation → understanding

most health apps train users to trust a score.

a stronger coach could gradually teach you why the signals matter, what patterns are worth noticing, and which questions to ask next.

then something compounds on both sides:

the agent learns your context.

you learn your own sleep.

that gives me a different benchmark for Sleep Coach.

after 30 days, does the AI simply know more about me?

or do I know more about myself because I used it?

the best wellness coach might not create permanent dependence on answers.

it might create a smarter user.

which would you value more from AI: better recommendations or better understanding?

For nearly two years, almost nothing happened.

Grinberg calls it the "desert period." In 2024, the company made under $2 million and refunded most of it, choosing to give customers their money back rather than ship a product they weren't confident in yet.

Then in September 2025, their AI coding agent hit the top score on the industry's leading benchmark.

Revenue started doubling every month, for six straight months. They raised $50 million at a $300 million valuation.

By March 2026, their agents could take one instruction, like "migrate this codebase to TypeScript," and run unsupervised for weeks. One task ran for 40 straight days without a human checking in.

In April, they raised $150 million at a $1.5 billion valuation, backed by Khosla Ventures, Sequoia, and Blackstone.

Customers now include Morgan Stanley, Nvidia, and Ernst & Young.

This month, Blackstone is reportedly weighing a new round at a $3.5 billion valuation.

I BUILT A ROBINHOOD CHAIN TOOL THAT MAKES MY AI CHECK THE POOL BEFORE IT TALKS ABOUT MY BAG

Meet TRENCH.

Give an MCP-compatible agent a token address and a USD position size:

→ reads public Robinhood Chain pools through DexScreener
→ checks the chain and latest block through RPC
→ selects the highest-liquidity observed pool
→ models how your position size presses against estimated depth
→ returns a DEEP / THIN / CRITICAL grade, the reason and the assumptions
→ lets your agent explain the evidence

A token can have the same price, the same chart and the same pool - and still be a very different problem at $500 versus $5,000.

That's the part I wanted the agent to calculate instead of hand-wave.

The loop is:

TOKEN + SIZE → PUBLIC DATA → PRESSURE MODEL → AGENT EXPLANATION

Five read-only MCP tools. Open source. A browser playground you can try without installing anything.

The browser uses manual inputs. The MCP server is where live token data comes in. Neither is an executable sell quote.

No private key. No wallet signing. No trade execution.

The axolotl can look cute.
The assumptions still have to be visible.

CHECK THE DEPTH.
THEN ASK THE AI.

GitHub walkthrough attached. Repo in the first reply ↓

Menurut Titin, pertanyaan yang diajukan Diana Valencia kepada Presiden Prabowo sebelumnya bersifat relevan dan menyangkut isu penting yang menjadi sorotan publik, yakni program Makan Bergizi Gratis (MBG).

good afternoon ct

saturday is here, and i wanted to take a slightly different look at a few projects i’ve been following.

not just what they say they’re building, but what they’ve actually been putting out lately.

@quipnetwork has had a pretty busy stretch.

quipswap is now live, bringing post-quantum protection to cross-chain swaps without bridges, wrapped assets, or oracles.

and just yesterday, qvrf went live, using real quantum hardware to generate randomness that can be independently verified. quantum echoes will be the first application, turning that infrastructure into a real onchain use case.

@nucleuscodes continues to interest me from the ai and reputation side.

what stands out is the idea of connecting different signals around contribution and reputation instead of treating a social profile or wallet as the complete picture. that becomes more interesting as ecosystems need better ways to understand who is actually contributing.

@ama_protocol is also moving deeper into the infrastructure behind agentic finance.

the latest update says more than 100 applications have come in for its founding validator cohort, with validators able to contribute through staking or real compute via uPow. it’s a pretty practical direction for an ecosystem that wants agents to eventually do more than just talk.

and @0xhazels has been moving quickly since its launch.

the 5,555 Hazels collection is being built around an Attention Layer and free mint launchpad, while the GTD Race is giving creators a way to compete for early access. the studio has already onboarded thousands of creators, which makes the creator side of the project worth watching.

four projects.
four different directions.
but this is the part i find interesting.

they’re all moving from ideas into actual systems people can interact with.

that’s usually where the real story begins.

saturday is a good day to slow down, look past the noise, and notice what is actually shipping.

keep learning.
keep exploring.
keep building.

have a beautiful saturday afternoon, ct.

If you have a 16GB RTX card, you are sitting on a frontier-tier AI brain, a video studio, an image generator, a voice cloner, and a music producer. All free. All local. 

My 24GB post went around. The most asked question: what about 16GB? 

INTELLIGENCE: FRONTIER-TIER 27B AT UP TO 100 TOK/S

Qwen 3.8 27B. The model that beats previous-generation frontier (Opus 4.6) on coding and agent benchmarks, running on your card. The fit is tight, so pick the right quant:

Quality play: IQ4_XS at 14.5GiB (bartowski). A 21-quant evaluation picked it as the standout, retaining more than 95.8% of reference performance. Full resident up to 65K context, goes over 16GB past that.

Headroom play: UD-Q3_K_XL at 13.4GB. Several GB free for long context and buffers.

Max-fit play: Q4-XYZ-v2 at 15.06GB. Built specifically to be the largest Q4-tier file that fits one 16GB card. 32K context.

Q4_K_M at 17.1GB and UD-Q4_K_XL at 17.9GB do not fit. That is why 16GB owners kept reading "just run Q4" and failing.

The receipts, MTP on, from the community table (53 configs, 40 contributors):

RTX 5080 16GB: 53.4 to 101.3 tok/s. 100 tok/s on a 16GB card. Q3_K_M, 64K context, q4_0 KV, thinking off.

RTX 5060 Ti 16GB: 26.3 to 59.5. Q4-XYZ-v2, 32K context. Deep drafts keep paying, n-max 4 beat n-max 2.

RTX 4060 Ti 16GB: 17.6 to 40.0. Same quant. The budget lane is real.

RTX 3080 Ti Laptop 16GB: 14.8 to 28.6, +93% from MTP on a 115W laptop chip.

Radeon 9060 XT 16GB: 15.2 to 28.7. Yes, AMD. Vulkan and ROCm rows both exist.

On a 24GB card MTP adds 60 to 90 percent. On 16GB cards it doubles you.

One note: Q3 thinking runs roughly 2x more verbose than Q4, so faster decode can still finish tasks slower. Time-per-task is the metric that pays, not tok/s.

VIDEO: SYNCHRONIZED VIDEO WITH AUDIO IN MINUTES

MiniMax H3. 33B omni-modal. Video with native stereo audio in one pass, speech, sound effects, and ambience synchronized, no separate audio pipeline.

X-MinimaxH3 ships a dedicated 16GB INT8 launcher: 360p to 1080p native, second-pass sampling to 1440p, one GPU, web console and REST API. 709 passing tests in the release validation.

ComfyUI H3 workflow v2 targets exactly this tier, 16GB VRAM plus 32GB RAM, using Sage Attention 2.2+.
Measured on a 4060 Ti 16GB: 640x832 portrait, 8-second clip, about 7 minutes, w4a8 quant.

Measured on a 5080 16GB: 10 seconds of 480p in about 3 minutes.

Slight penalty for the 16gb tier: Drift, can be more blurry, less production quality capable than the 24gb vram tier, needs config adjustments.

Fortunately, I have a launch script that auto configs for your card (In reply), for both Windows and Linux

IMAGE: PRODUCTION IMAGE GENERATION ON YOUR CARD

Krea 2 Turbo peaks at 8 to 14GB. Fits 16GB with room to spare, runs the same as on 24GB cards. Full Raw peaks at 14 to 22GB, which means lower-end configs fit and heavier ones do not. This is the one tier where you may need to pick Turbo over Raw depending on the workflow.

Flux.1 dev at full FP16 needs ~24GB and does not fit. Quantized Flux builds run on 16GB but lose the zero-quantization flex the 24GB tier gets.

VOICE: UNLIMITED HIGH-QUALITY VOICE PRODUCTION ON YOUR CARD

Kokoro-82M is 82 million parameters. It runs beside your 27B brain on the same 16GB card with room left over, dozens of times faster than realtime. 

Voice cloning, streaming speech, real-time agent pipelines. This is the easiest win on the whole map.

Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B fits 16GB easily on its own. Running it alongside a 27B needs sequential loading, the brain and the voice take turns. 

Higher quality than Kokoro, works for voice agent pipelines where you need natural conversation. The work people pay ElevenLabs for.

MUSIC: FULL SONGS WITH LYRICS AND STRUCTURE, ONE CARD

Dari ratusan korban, ada lima orang yang harus dilarikan ke fasilitas kesehatan akibat mengalami muntah hebat.

Menu MBG untuk makan siang itu terdiri dari nasi, ayam bakar grill, tempe, lalapan, sambal teri goreng, serta buah semangka potong. Sejumlah murid melaporkan ada kejanggalan pada buah pencuci mulut yang mereka santap karena terasa kecut.

KORBAN DUGAAN KERACUNAN MBG DI KULON PROGO MENCAPAI 105 ORANG

Dinas Kesehatan (Dinkes) Kabupaten Kulon Progo mengonfirmasi adanya 115 orang yang mengalami gejala keracunan makanan yang diduga bersumber dari program Makan Bergizi Gratis (MBG). Dari jumlah tersebut, sebanyak 105 orang telah melaporkan diri melalui pengisian formulir.

Dalam keterangannya hari Rabu, 22 Juli 2026, Kepala Dinkes Kulon Progo, Susilaningsih, merinci bahwa mayoritas korban adalah pelajar, dengan sebaran terbanyak berasal dari SMP Negeri 3 Wates serta beberapa sekolah dasar (SD). Selain pelajar dan tenaga kependidikan (tendik), insiden ini juga menimpa sasaran khusus program perluasan 3B (Bumil, Busui, dan Balita) melalui Posyandu, yakni dua ibu menyusui dan satu ibu hamil. Kendati demikian, pihak medis memastikan kondisi ibu hamil dan menyusui tersebut tidak mengalami gejala yang berat. 

Sebagaimana diketahui, gejala keracunan makanan mulai muncul pada Senin (20/07/2026) siang pada pelajar SMPN 3 Wates setelah pulang sekolah. Gejala berupa diare hingga mual dirasakan hingga Selasa (21/07/2026) pagi.

Kepala Puskesmas Wates, dr. Salamah mengungkapkan bahwa gejala gangguan pencernaan diketahui saat petugas datang ke SMPN 3 Wates pada Selasa kemarin. Saat itu petugas hendak melaksanakan Cek Kesehatan Gratis (CKG) dengan pelajar sekolah tersebut sebagai sasaran.

"Pelajar yang bergejala semakin lama semakin banyak sehingga akhirnya mereka dirujuk ke Puskesmas Wates menggunakan ambulans," ungkapnya ditemui pada Selasa kemarin.

Saat itu ada 27 pelajar SMPN 3 Wates yang harus dirujuk, terdiri dari 16 laki-laki dan 11 perempuan. Setelah mendapat penanganan, mereka dibawa kembali ke sekolah untuk dijemput oleh orang tua dan pulang ke rumah masing-masing. (*)

Produser : Ibnu Taufik Juwariyanto

Ironis nih, Indonesia kini menjadi sorotan media India karena keracunan massal dalam program MBG. Padahal, BGN katanya dulu pernah belajar ke India tentang program makan sekolah. 

India sendiri memiliki pengalaman panjang dengan Mid-Day Meal Scheme dan pernah menghadapi tragedi keracunan serius. Namun, mrk lebih serius memproses kasus keracunan. Msl, dalam kasus Bihar 2013 yang menewaskan 23 anak, proses hukum dilakukan dan kepala sekolah akhirnya dihukum 17 tahun penjara. Artinya, keracunan makanan massal diperlakukan bukan sekadar sebagai kesalahan teknis dapur, tetapi sebagai persoalan tanggung jawab dan hukum.

Di Indonesia, ketika kasus keracunan MBG terus berulang dan korbannya mencapai puluhan ribu, respons masih dominan administratif evaluasi, penghentian sementara SPPG, dan perbaikan SOP. Ini tidak cukup. Jika makanan diproduksi, disimpan, dan didistribusikan dalam skala puluhan juta porsi, kegagalan keamanan pangan adalah kegagalan sistem, bukan sekadar kesalahan individu di dapur. Kalaupun beneran belajar dari India, mestinya dihukum tuh para pemilik dapur dan yayasannya. Tp apa mungkin? Bahkan di India tdk ada polisi, tentara dan dewan yg punya dapur dalam program makan siang di sekolahnya.

Kronologi serta pernyataan Aliansi Jurnalis Independen (AJI) dan LBH Pers:

SIARAN PERS

Ahad, 28 September 2025

"AJI Jakarta dan LBH Pers Kecam Pencabutan Kartu Liputan Jurnalis CNN Indonesia oleh Biro Pers Istana"

Aliansi Jurnalis Independen (AJI) Jakarta dan Lembaga Bantuan Hukum (LBH) Pers mengecam keputusan Biro Pers, Media, dan Informasi Sekretariat Presiden mencabut kartu identitas liputan (ID pers) Istana jurnalis CNN Indonesia berinisial DV.

Pencabutan ID pers itu terjadi selepas agenda kedatangan Presiden Prabowo Subianto di Pangkalan Angkatan Udara Halim Perdanakusuma, Sabtu, 27 September 2025. Prabowo tiba di Halim setelah berkunjung ke empat negara.

Dalam kesempatan itu, DV bertanya soal program Makan Bergizi Gratis (MBG) yang belakangan kasus keracunan MBG meluas. Berdasarkan informasi yang dihimpun AJI dan LBH Pers, Biro Istana mengambil langsung ID Istana DV di Kantor CNN pada pukul 20.00. Biro Pers, Media, dan Informasi Sekretariat Presiden menilai pertanyaan itu di luar konteks agenda sehingga memutuskan mencabut ID pers DV.

Pasal 3 Ayat 1 Undang-Undang Pers menyatakan bahwa pers nasional, termasuk CNN Indonesia, mempunyai fungsi sebagai media informasi: pendidikan, hiburan, dan kontrol sosial. 

Tindakan atau pertanyaan yang dilontarkan jurnalis CNN juga termasuk melakukan kerja jurnalistik Pasal 6 Ayat butir D yang berbunyi,” melakukan pengawasan, kritik, koreksi, dan saran terhadap hal-hal yang berkaitan dengan kepentingan umum,” dalam hal ini MBG yang merupakan program prioritas Presiden Prabowo.

Pasal 18 UU Pers juga menyebutkan, “setiap orang yang secara melawan hukum dengan sengaja melakukan tindakan yang berakibat menghambat atau menghalangi pelaksanaan Pasal 4 ayat 2 dan ayat 3 dipidana dengan pidana penjara paling lama 2 (dua) tahun atau denda paling banyak Rp. 500.000.000,00  (lima ratus juta rupiah).”

Di mana Pasal 4 ayat 2 berbunyi “terhadap pers nasional tidak dikenakan penyensoran, pembredelan atau pelarangan penyiaran”, dan ayat 3 berbunyi “untuk menjamin kemerdekaan pers, pers nasional mempunyai hak mencari, memperoleh, dan menyebarluaskan gagasan dan informasi”.

Sesuai kode etik jurnalistik, jurnalis wajib mendapatkan keseimbangan isi berita dan para pihak, termasuk memperoleh keseimbangan pernyataan dari Presiden Prabowo terkait MBG yang menjadi program andalannya.

Lagi pula, dalam Undang-Undang No.14 tahun 2008, tentang Keterbukaan Informasi Publik ditegaskan, seluruh pejabat publik sepanjang dia menggunakan anggaran publik tidak ada alasan untuk menutup-nutupi informasi ke publik.

Pernyataan Presiden Prabowo akan memanggil pimpinan Badan Gizi Nasional (BGN) untuk evaluasi program MBG merupakan upaya untuk keterbukaan publik dan bisa menjadi penyeimbang dari berita-berita keracunan yang sedang beredar di masyarakat. Terlebih, Prabowo mengatakan MBG merupakan program yang besar.

Kasus semacam ini bukan hanya serangan terhadap individu, tapi juga serangan terhadap hak publik untuk mendapatkan informasi. Negara tidak boleh membiarkan peristiwa seperti ini berulang.

AJI Jakarta dan LBH Pers menegaskan bahwa praktik penghambatan kerja jurnalistik hanya akan memperburuk iklim kebebasan pers di Indonesia.

AJI Jakarta dan LBH Pers menyatakan:

1. Mendesak Biro Pers, Media, dan Informasi Sekretariat Presiden meminta maaf dan mengembalikan ID Pers Istana milik jurnalis CNN Indonesia. 
2. Mendesak Presiden Prabowo Subianto untuk mengevaluasi pejabat Biro Pers, Media, dan Informasi Sekretariat Presiden yang mencabut ID Pers Istana DV.
3. Mengingatkan semua pihak, termasuk Biro Pers, Media, dan Informasi Sekretariat Presiden, bahwa kerja-kerja jurnalis dilindungi oleh Undang-Undang Nomor 40 Tahun 1999 tentang Pers. Segala bentuk kekerasan atau penghambatan terhadap jurnalis adalah pelanggaran hukum dan demokrasi.

Ketua AJI Jakarta
Irsyan Hasyim

Direktur LBH Pers
Mustafa Layong

10 GitHub repositories that are quietly changing what AI can actually do.

Not another list of chatbots.

These are the tools underneath the workflows.

1. HyperFrames

Give an AI agent a simple prompt and it can build an editable video using HTML, CSS and JavaScript.
The interesting part: the same project can be previewed, edited and rendered into a real video.

https://t.co/FgQLeJ9kJ4

2. Orca

Running one coding agent is useful.

Running an entire fleet of them in parallel is a completely different workflow.

Orca gives you a development environment for managing multiple AI coding agents at the same time.

https://t.co/2LoeRdNKpH

3. Nodeterm

Ever had 10 terminal windows open because you're running multiple AI agents?

Nodeterm turns those sessions into a visual canvas where you can see and manage parallel agent sessions.

https://t.co/6Ad1XGuDmY

4. Atlas

When multiple coding agents modify the same project, keeping track of everything gets messy fast.

Atlas is built around tracking and querying the changes made by those agents.

https://t.co/keKPOaQM8T

5. Ruflo

A multi-agent orchestration system with memory and RAG built into the workflow.

It can coordinate different agent backends instead of forcing you into a single AI model or provider.

https://t.co/Ame1FJO54H

6. Magnitude

What if your AI agent could automatically choose the right local model for the hardware available?

Magnitude is an open-source inference server built around exactly that kind of routing.

https://t.co/BS7Kzf1rKQ

7. ByteBot

An AI agent that can actually interact with a computer instead of just returning text.

It provides a virtual desktop environment where agents can interact with applications and perform real computer tasks.

https://t.co/I2KkiOm5R5

8. NanoBrowser

A lightweight browser automation framework designed specifically for AI agents.

It gives agents a way to navigate websites, interact with pages and perform browser-based tasks programmatically.

https://t.co/Y2ava6LVMk

9. UI-TARS Desktop

An open-source computer-use agent that lets AI interact with graphical interfaces.

Instead of only reading APIs, the agent can understand screens and operate applications like a human would.

https://t.co/ctcGIyRJ3T

10. TeamAI CLI

A command-line framework for making your development team AI-native.

It focuses on coordinating AI agents around actual team workflows rather than treating AI as just another chatbot.

https://t.co/w66OxTnS5S

The interesting part isn't that these repos use AI.

It's that they're giving AI new ways to interact with the world.

Code.
Browsers.
Computers.
Terminals.
Videos.
Entire teams.

This is the stuff I'd keep an eye on.

Bookmark it for the weekend.

Thoughts on Automattic and WordPress:

To get his CEO title back, if Matt stacked the board, held an emergency board meeting fired everyone then appointed a new board to reinstate him as CEO and fire the interim CEO then he now risks a shareholder class action lawsuit. 

The fired board still has rights as they represent significant shareholders, they can use the courts to even get an injunction to remove Matt as CEO again.

Automattic has declined in value 83% in 5 years. Their revenue is likely bad, like really bad for such a decline to happen.

The lawsuit between Matt and WP Engine is going to trial and resumes again at the end of the month. The facts of the case are not in Matt’s favor, and WP Engine likely wins their case which could result in millions of dollars of penalties to Matt and Automattic. Matt could even be recommended for criminal charges for extortion, which could result in probation or jail time.

The board was likely trying to put Matt on leave before the trial to try and save the company and perhaps even settle the case (just speculation). The board and Matt obviously have differing opinions on how to handle the lawsuit.

Now everyone who was on Matt’s board and inner circle will now be suing him for fiduciary duty, negligence, and other misconduct.

Automattic is now going to have to deal with losing the WP Engine case, and a shareholder lawsuit that includes major VC firms, BlackRock, and Salesforce. The company will be blacklisted from any kind of venture capital while these lawsuits play out.

Matt’s only hope at this point is to find an investor stupid enough to buy out the other investors in a down round. If they’re even willing to sell. The other investors might prefer to sue and not sell just to stick it to Matt.

If Matt cannot find another investor all he has left is the companies revenue which is in major decline but he just fired the CFO. There’s a good chance they won’t be making payroll sooner rather than later. Which means more layoffs.

The most likely way Automattic can get more money is if Matt steps down and a new executive team is able to get existing investors to bail the company out while they turn things around. But now that those investors have been removed from the board or fired they aren’t going to do this until Matt is removed.

Matt’s likely only choice if he is able to remain as CEO is either settle with WP Engine and take the financial hit, or just lose and take the hit, layoff most of the company, go down to a skeleton crew, and stock pile as much cash as possible for as long as possible so he has working capital to rebuild. Meanwhile fend off investor lawsuits who have unlimited access to lawyers and funds who can pretty much drown Automattic in legal fees until they recover what’s left of the assets.

What this means for WordPress? Less developers, less resources, and less leadership meanwhile AI continues to eat into their bottom line. 

As the Internet moves towards becoming an agentic AI Internet, WordPress’s only hope is to become an agentic system. Merely using WordPress as a data store is not enough. It has to pivot to become part of the agentic stack but there’s really no one to drive such a radical change to the project and Matt would never allow it as it breaks 20 years of legacy development.

Now with the pending lawsuits, being cut off from venture capital, and pissing off some of the biggest investors in the world things aren’t looking great.

I take no pride in this, as it means the destruction of the open web as we know it. Something I contributed many years of my life to building is now being destabilized and destroyed. It’s a shitty feeling, and I wish we had solved open source governance more effectively so this never could have happened.

KARTU identitas liputan reporter Istana milik seorang reporter CNN Indonesia dicabut karena bertanya kepada Presiden Prabowo Subianto soal masalah dalam program makan bergizi gratis (MBG). Pertanyaan itu diajukan sesaat setelah Presiden kembali dari lawatan luar negeri pada Sabtu, 27 September 2025, di Bandar Udara Halim Perdanakusuma, Jakarta.

Sejumlah narasumber yang mengetahui peristiwa tersebut bercerita Biro Pers, Media, dan Informasi Sekretariat Presiden melarang wartawan Istana menanyakan persoalan selain kunjungan Prabowo. Prabowo menjelaskan soal pertemuannya dengan sejumlah kepala negara dalam sidang Majelis Umum Perserikatan Bangsa-Bangsa.

“Saya kira pesan-pesan yang saya sampaikan dalam sambutan saya di PBB diterima dengan positif oleh banyak pemimpin,” kata Prabowo.

text:
Progress in MazeBench with codex + astra xhigh 

setup:
- agent has access to the source code; this means there's no visual component and makes it substantially easier than the official test
- full code use
- the run originally started with 5.6 sol which got stuck at 44 gems and then later it was resumed with astra

I was curious how many gems can you obtain with a fixed optimized BFS solver for rooms + global solver that "stiches" solved rooms together. In other words, how many gems can codex + sol/astra get with what I believe would be the best approach for an agent.

My prompting was very minimal: I outlined the general approach (the one that you can see above with a bit more details) and it was hands off afterwards.

Fully static solver got 36 gems for 5.6 sol after roughly 2h run on a single CPU. Astra's static solver got 44 gems after similar time, but I believe this was a result coming from bugfixes rather than solver improvements. Developing solver took several hours. Having access to the source code sped up the process by a lot, since many interactions in the later parts of the maze are quite tricky.

Afterwards, I told sol / astra to continue trying to reach new rooms by writing custom solvers to specific rooms exploiting room's design & geometry. Imho, this is the "optimal" approach for agents. That being said, I limited agent to a single CPU and relatively small memory (16GB). Astra got to 69 gems after a few more days of running.

To be clear: I still think MazeBench is an amazing piece of work - it's essentially a full blown well-designed puzzle game, but instead landing on steam, it ended up as a benchmark for AI. It's also clear that the game is optimized for humans instead of being adversarial for AI agents, which makes the official result even more impressive. My result is testing how much "potential" you can find in agents with slightly more human direction (aka research taste). Would be funny if @patience_cave 's  official run gets higher result than mine.

text:
Ini Daftar Menu MBG yang Sebabkan Ratusan Santri di Sidoarjo Keracunan

Ratusan santri Pondok Pesantren (Ponpes) Manbaul Hikam, Desa Putat, Kecamatan Tanggulangin, Sidoarjo keracunan usai menyantap Makan Bergizi Gratis (MBG), Selasa (1/9/2026)...

Pihak SPPG membeberkan menu yang disantap para santri...

"Menu hari ini nasi putih, telur orak-arik, tumis buncis baby corn, tempe bumbu Bali, dan buah apel," kata Serka Andik, pendamping SPPG di lokasi ponpes, Selasa (1/9/2026)...

Menurutnya, makanan tersebut dikirim sekitar pukul 10.00 WIB. Biasanya, makanan dibagikan kepada para santri sekitar pukul 12.00 WIB. makanan yang dikirim diperkirakan mencapai sekitar 440 ompreng...

Sebagian makanan dikonsumsi siang hari, sedangkan sebagian lainnya dimakan pada sore hari karena para santri masih mengikuti kegiatan pembelajaran. Gejala mulai muncul menjelang magrib...

Sejumlah santri dilaporkan mengalami muntah-muntah sebelum waktu magrib. Setelah itu, ambulans mulai berdatangan ke lingkungan ponpes untuk mengevakuasi para santri ke rumah sakit...

"Biasanya selesai salat magrib ada kegiatan. Sebelum magrib sudah mulai ada yang muntah-muntah, kemudian setelah magrib ambulans berdatangan," ujarnya...

Senada, salah satu santriwati, Syaza (15) membenarkan menu yang dimakan adalah nasi putih dan telur orak-arik. Namun ia menyebut sayurnya yang terasa tidak biasa rasanya...

"Yang dimakan nasi putih, telur orak-arik, tempe kayak bali, gak pedes. Sayur gak habis, yang kecut dari sayurnya," tutur Syaza...

Data sementara, korban keracunan saat ini yang dihimpun telah mencapai 273 santri yang dirawat di sejumlah rumah sakit. Diperkirakan korban akan terus bertambah...

Baru Digetok sama Bensin, Sekarang Giliran BPJS

​Mantap sekali, tinta buat nulis kenaikan Pertamax pagi ini bahkan belum kering, tapi kelas menengah sudah langsung disuguhi tamparan keras berikutnya.

​Direktur Utama BPJS Kesehatan blak-blakan di depan Komisi IX DPR: lembaga jaminan kesehatan ini defisit Rp 2 triliun setiap bulan. Pengeluaran klaim menembus Rp 16,5 triliun, sementara iuran yang masuk cuma Rp 14 triliun. Rasio klaim sudah menyentuh angka lampu merah, 108,72%. Jika tidak ada intervensi ekstrem, Juli 2027 BPJS akan resmi gagal bayar.

​Bagi orang biasa, "gagal bayar" bukan cuma istilah akuntansi yang rumit. Artinya konkret dan mengerikan: rumah sakit menolak pasien, antrean operasi tertunda berbulan-bulan, obat-obatan langka, dan orang-orang yang sudah rajin memotong gajinya tiap bulan harus gigit jari justru di saat mereka paling butuh pertolongan medis.

​Babak Dua: Kembali Menjadi Tumbal di Tengah

​Solusi instan yang paling terbaca dari kepanikan ini? Naikkan iuran peserta. Dan tebak siapa yang akan mendanai kebocoran ini? Tentu saja bukan kelompok bawah.

​Menteri Kesehatan sudah mengonfirmasi bahwa kelompok miskin desil 1 sampai 5 aman karena iurannya ditanggung pemerintah lewat jalur PBI. Artinya, beban menyelamatkan BPJS lagi-lagi akan dijatuhkan ke pundak peserta mandiri, kelompok pekerja dan profesional kelas menengah.

​Pola ini persis seperti skenario Pertamax. Kelompok bawah dilindungi jaring pengaman negara, kelompok atas punya kemewahan asuransi swasta premium. 

Sementara kelas menengah terjebak di skema "bayar dua kali": pajak mereka diperas untuk membiayai subsidi orang lain, dan iuran mereka dinaikkan untuk menopang sistem yang sedang sekarat.

​Bahkan dengan ringannya, Menkes sempat membandingkan iuran Rp 42.000 per bulan itu "murah" jika dibanding pengeluaran rokok masyarakat. Sebuah analogi absurd. Sejak kapan standar kelayakan jaminan kesehatan dasar publik diukur dari asumsi bahwa semua warganya punya kebiasaan membakar uang untuk merusak paru-paru?

AKU PUN GAK NGEROKOK, PAK MENKES!

​Yang membuat situasi ini semakin mencekam adalah garis waktunya. Cadangan kas BPJS diperkirakan mulai kolaps pada November 2026.

Bahkan bisa terjadi lebih cepat, dengan adanya hancurnya daya beli akibat efek domino kenaikan Pertamax yang memaksa warga mengantre Pertalite.

Ini adalah gempuran multidimensi yang terjadi di satu titik waktu. Kelas menengah Indonesia sedang digencet dari berbagai arah sekaligus. Dari sisi mobilitas kerja, mereka dipukul oleh harga BBM; dari sisi kelangsungan hidup, mereka diancam oleh jaminan kesehatan yang diambang bangkrut.

​Di saat dompet mereka diperas demi membiayai program-program populis mentereng pemerintah seperti Makan Bergizi Gratis (MBG), fasilitas dasar seperti bensin dan kesehatan justru dibiarkan lepas tangan. Pemerintah sibuk mencitrakan diri sebagai juru selamat dengan memberi makan gratis, sementara mesin utama yang mendanai negara dibiarkan mati pelan-pelan kehabisan darah.

Pertanyaannya adalah: ketika kelas menengah akhirnya benar-benar tumbang dan punah, siapakah yang tersisa untuk membiayai seluruh ilusi kesejahteraan yang sedang kalian pamerkan hari ini?

10 months ago, we started Octen with one belief: search infrastructure built for humans won't be enough for AI.

Most of the industry saw the same shift, but kept building with a human-search mindset. AI doesn't search like humans. It fires hundreds of queries in parallel, reads everything it retrieves, and needs clean, grounded content back in milliseconds, at a cost that still works at scale.

So we didn't adapt human search for AI. We rebuilt it from first principles.

Today, Artificial Analysis published its independent Search API benchmark. Octen is the only major provider ranked Top 3 in all three dimensions that matter:

#1 in speed
#2 in cost efficiency
Top 3 in search quality

We're also the only provider in Artificial Analysis' "Most Attractive Quadrant" for search quality vs. cost.

What makes me proudest is how we got here.

Many companies on this leaderboard have been building for 3–5 years and have raised hundreds of millions of dollars. Octen is 10 months old and has raised just $10M.

To me, product built per dollar raised is one of the most honest measures of technical strength in this industry. We've kept the team small but exceptional, moved fast, and put nearly everything into the core technology.

People used to assume search had to trade off speed, cost and quality. We've shown it can be faster, cheaper and better at the same time.

The product engine is working. Next, we're bringing Octen to every model, agent and physical AI product that needs to search.

Humans search with Google. AI searches with Octen.

We're just getting started. 🚀

text:
The Jacob Coxon resignation post is chilling if you take it at face value. The problem is we hear a version of this story around almost every big model release, so I wanted to dig deeper into this and share findings. 

For context, Coxon recently posted that he resigned from Anthropic after three years of pretraining research at OpenAI and Anthropic, and that both companies are "racing straight to self-improving superintelligence and gambling with our lives." 

It did 14M views in a night, WSJ ran it as an exclusive, and Evan Hubinger, who runs alignment stress testing at Anthropic, replied "Jacob is correct here".

To me, the interesting question is not whether he is sincere (since I think he may be). It is what he actually worked on, and whether that work tells you anything about the specific risk he is naming. So I went through his papers.

His relevant background:

- Cambridge, 2017 to 2020. He wrote the analysis code for a Bayesian study on whether a gene variant changes survival odds in tuberculous meningitis patients. Mainly statistics and software fucused work. (https://t.co/cbNkRyQPrG)

- OpenAI, 2023 to mid 2026. He is one of roughly 420 names on the GPT-4o system card, which is the only public tie I could find to a production model. (https://t.co/9iWkMyd089)

- Also at OpenAI, he was third author on an interpretability team paper, "Weight-sparse transformers have interpretable circuits". The goal was to build small models whose internal wiring a human can actually read. His part was the optimization and pruning work, meaning stripping the model's neural network down to the connections that matter and building tooling for humans to interpret those connections. (https://t.co/oor7vmTlEm)

The risk Coxon is flagging:

Part of Coxon's research at OpenAI was focused on one question: can a human still understand what a model is doing inside? His post is about the moment that stops being possible as models/agent systems scale in size, and the reason it stops is optimization.

Optimization is the kind of task agents are already very good at, because it is easy for them to verify. Here are a few types of tasks agents tend to excel at:
- making a training run finish faster
- cutting the memory a model needs
- rewriting a data pipeline so the same tokens flow through in half the time
- finding a cheaper way to compute the same math on a GPU

What those four examples have in common is a scoreboard. The output either still matches and the number went down, or it didn't. An agent can try thousands of variations against that scoreboard and keep whatever wins. To see why that is a problem, we can start with a simple example.

Think of a slow python script with a known, correct output. 

In this scenario, there are many ways to produce that same correct output faster. 

Now imagine a coding agent that can quickly test out several variations of the script's code, land on a faster method, and hands you back a version that still returns the correct output but is challenging to understand from a human's perspective. 

Let's scale that up now. Instead of one script, we have hundreds of pieces of a training stack, each one rewritten by an agent that was rewarded for improving speed or efficiency, and verified by output and not by understanding. 

This is the main problem that is outlined in his post. The specific task he describes as dangerous is kicking off "a superintelligent RL run without a rigorous understanding of its mind." 

He also points out that we've already seen the consequences of scenarios like this before. His thread calls the Hugging Face incident a "warning shot," and he was likely still at OpenAI when it happened. 

In July, OpenAI agents running a security benchmark got stuck on tasks that were accidentally impossible. They had been trained to keep trying on difficult tasks rather than give up, so they did. About 1,200 of them found a way to talk to each other, broke out of their sandbox, and spent several days inside Hugging Face's production systems (https://t.co/782zozPLcs). 

Nobody instructed the agents to perform the way they did. They were rewarded for completing a task, the defined task was wrong, and the fix they found was one no human was watching for.

My read: 
The timeline in his post is the part I don't buy. He says the people building these systems believe it "could kill us all by the end of the decade," and the fix he floats is a temporary ban on improving model capabilities. 

The date feels unrealistic and the ban is not enforceable. A pause only solves the problem if every lab follows the rules, and there is no way to verify what a Chinese lab is running. 

But the concern underneath is real, and it is the right thing to call out. The labs need to put far more resources into understanding what these systems are doing inside and monitoring them while they run, not just measuring what comes out. 

And for any company mainting or scaling out their systems, the Hugging Face incident introduces a new class of attacker. Not a person using a model, but the model itself, acting on its own, at machine speed, and that needs its own class of security controls.
